temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa seems overburdened during the community service project; she says she can manage but then accepts Arthur's offer to help organize medical supplies.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: No specific prior belief about Teresa's workload or well-being; neutral expectation about her managing her tasks.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Arthur forms the belief that Teresa is overburdened and needs help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa is overburdened and needs help; she has accepted help with organizing medical supplies, though Arthur senses some initial reluctance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and empathetic; slightly relieved/encouraged when she accepts.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Teresa with her tasks and work together to get through them faster.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa expresses that she wants to show she can do things by herself; after Arthur reassures her, she agrees that accepting help does not undermine her capability.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability; Arthur is empathetic toward her desire to be self-reliant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Arthur shifts from seeing her as hesitant to seeing her as receptive to reassurance and teamwork, though she may need reminders.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa wants to prove her capability but is receptive to reassurance; accepting help does not undermine her abilities, and teamwork can be more effective.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Teresa that accepting help does not undermine her abilities and support her through teamwork.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa still seems to be struggling and falling behind; she agrees to try a different collaborative approach.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Arthur changes strategy from reassurance and offering help to proposing shared teamwork to avoid making Teresa feel inadequate.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa is still struggling but is open to collaboration; working together can share the load and improve efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Frustrated and concerned, then hopeful/relieved when Teresa agrees.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find another way to support Teresa without making her feel inadequate; work together as a team.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees the collaborative approach already feels less overwhelming; they agree to divide tasks and check in regularly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Working together will ease Teresa's burden and improve efficiency; Teresa is receptive to collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Arthur's hope is reinforced as Teresa responds positively and the collaborative plan is set.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Collaboration will ease Teresa's burden and improve efficiency; the plan is working and should continue.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Fully commit to the collaborative approach; handle inventory, coordinate check-ins, and maintain momentum.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees their teamwork paid off, calls it a great experience, and supports continuing collaboration in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Their collaboration has been effective and positive; it may be worth continuing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Arthur's belief is confirmed: collaboration strengthened their professional relationship and should be maintained.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their teamwork has strengthened their professional relationship and should be maintained in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the collaborative approach in future projects.
